draft.title: RhoGov — Decisions That Learn
draft.purpose: Can a newcomer on a phone understand a meaningful decision and make a first contribution?
draft.authorizedAction: Run one low-impact decision on the playground with test REV, then show what changed.
draft.scope: One invitation, one short explanation, one decision, one visible follow-up. Recruitment and scheduling count toward team effort.
draft.expectedResult: At least 7 of 10 consenting newcomers have a valid ballot recorded within 5 minutes without individual assistance.
draft.dissent: Identity setup, faucet availability, voter eligibility or unclear instructions may block participation.
draft.evidencePlan: Use P01–P10. Time starts when the invitation opens, including setup and eligibility waits. Record every attempt, assistance, withdrawals and unknowns. Check ballot evidence; retain missing and disputed observations. Assess the earliest opened attempt per participant.
